section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the statistical testing of a hypothesized structural model with 249 participants using Mplus software. The analysis examined relationships among restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages, attachment anxiety/avoidance, perfectionism dimensions, body appreciation, depressive symptoms, and intuitive eating, with BMI controlled as a covariate. The final model demonstrated good fit and revealed that body appreciation was predicted by multiple factors and in turn predicted intuitive eating, with substantial variance explained across model variables.
